race.comment: DALT JAZ (1) built on a nice third two starts back at Townsville with success over 1000m there two-and-a-half weeks ago, getting home by a long neck. High on confidence and is likely to be in the finish again. HUMBLE HERO (7) scored last start at Rockhampton to make it three wins and three placings from six starts this campaign. Has the gate speed to take up a forward position and has solid claims on best form. LA PETITE MAISON (6) showed little early speed last start and failed to come on in the straight when 11th, beaten 5 lengths, over 1000m at Townsville. Best figures measure up nicely. Sure to run well from the low draw. TRIPLE TRIPLE (11) best of the rest from the inside marble.
